_meta.description: Works whose served text is known to be shorter than a fuller text of the SAME work held in this repo, with the intent to eventually supplement or replace the served text from it. Curated: each entry is a human decision that the fuller text really is the same work (a token ratio alone cannot establish that; a witness can be bigger because it prints apparatus, or because it is a different work, as issues #23 and #28 showed). Consumed by scripts/build_work_index.py, which writes a serving_deficit block onto the work's index entry and a column into the catalog.
_meta.policy: Entries carry NO token counts or ratios; every number is derived at build time from the named files, so it cannot go stale (the grave_residue lesson). The build FAILS if an entry's slug is not served, if fuller_in does not exist, or if the fuller text is not actually larger than the served text, so a resolved deficit must be removed or updated here in the same change that resolves it. fuller_in must be a file held in this repo, which keeps this disjoint from data/partial_ceilings.json, whose ceilings are external editions we do not hold.

constantinus-vii-porphyrogenitus-imperat.scope: serves the proem and lib. 1.1-83 of a work whose Canon scope is lib. 1.1-92; the missing chapters, and the whole of lib. 1.84-2.56 (tlg3023.010, a separate Canon work), are printed in PG112, verified by the served proem being verbatim identical to PG112 locus 44 and the book-2 head at locus 495
constantinus-vii-porphyrogenitus-imperat.reason: the served text is byzantium.gr's manual transcription and stays primary over our OCR of the same passages per the source-precedence ladder; the fuller text is uncorrected OCR
constantinus-vii-porphyrogenitus-imperat.intent: supplement the served work's missing tail from the PG112 text once it is carved and corrected, or replace the serving entirely if a fuller transcription or corrected edition becomes available
